title: Adam Optimizer Step
signature: def adam_step(param, grad, m, v, t, lr=1e-3, beta1=0.9, beta2=0.999, eps=1e-8) -> tuple
hints: Update the first moment m and the second moment v before using them.
Early on, m and v are biased toward zero because they start at zero. Divide by (1 - beta^t) to correct for it.
eps goes outside the square root: sqrt(v_hat) + eps.
